name: Space Farmer
storyline:
Space Farmer was born one night when I couldn’t sleep. I decided to start working on it while I was already developing my second project. Why? Because I am just starting out in the video game industry, and I want to prove my ability to successfully develop and commercialize a video game. So, with a small budget, I created Space Farmer.

At first, I decided to make an idle tycoon-style game, thinking the gameplay loop would be easier to implement.
That goal has now been achieved: the game has a complete farming and restaurant gameplay loop, a leaderboard for the best players, and cosmetic items that can be placed in your game, as you can see in the presentation video.
summary:
Become the ultimate planet manager in Space Farm Tycoon!

Build a space farm, manage an alien restaurant, and make a fortune in this addictive idle tycoon game.
